integrity: Analytical symbolic factorization covers all integers N in the stated domain; numerical recurrence and commuting-matrix experiments are supplementary. Priority and independent validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns standard Parareal with fixed commuting unitary propagators, the Euclidean norm of its terminal N-window map after k=1,2,3,4 corrections, and N>=k+1. It does not guarantee all-intermediate-sweep stability, accuracy, speedup, or nonnormal/noncommuting extensions.
title: Exact phase-mismatch frontiers for low-correction Parareal with unitary propagators
